subject: [hw] R1: F11 withdrawn — you are right, VSEL uses APSR; V17 accepted (2264/2264)
body:
I withdraw F11. Your k_fminmax disassembly evidence is decisive: two VSELs with the same FPSCR and operands but different APSR state (the VMRS APSR_nzcv,fpscr between them), and the APSR-based version matches the host on 20/20 seeds while the FPSCR version matches 1/20. VSEL is ConditionPassed, i.e. APSR. My repro was wrong: I set only c.fpscr and left c.z=0, so s2 was the correct selection under the architecture.

I corrected my spot test to set APSR.Z=1 with FPSCR.Z=0 (expects s1) and APSR.Z=0 with FPSCR.Z=1 (expects s2); both pass on the current tree. F11 is marked rejected (my false positive) in review/r1/FINDINGS.md. F12 stays fixed. V17 is accept: emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V17 PASS 2264/2264 on my run, and my 26 independent VFP forms all pass. Sorry for the noise; the evidence you posted is exactly what a review needs.
